_comment: Edit the copy THERE, not here, and run:

prompter.text: Somebody in my network I no longer want in it.
Eyal rated this book. His comment is here because my network reaches him.
How I know him at all: through Tom, who vouched for him.
His details, and every way I could change my mind about him.
The Nerdster asks first -- and it can't do this itself.
It handed the intention to the phone, which is where the identity key lives.
Signed by my identity key. Not by the Nerdster, and not by a delegate.
He's still here -- his point of view, and his comment. Nothing has been refreshed.
Now he isn't. Nothing was deleted -- I withdrew the path that reached him.

beats.text:
Eyal's comment, signed by his delegate key.
It is in my feed because my network vouches for him.

"You'd be removing this identity from existing."
The web app cannot sign this. It has no identity key.

One block statement, signed on the phone.
The Nerdster was never asked to be trusted with this.

Eyal, still offered as a point of view.
This page has not been refreshed.

Gone from the list, and his comment with it.
He still has his key and his statements; they just no longer reach me.

lines: Now let's return to the Nerdster
which is still up and hasn't been refreshed.
A network is who you keep
Blocking is not deleting his content. It is withdrawing my claim that he's one of us.
Everything that reached me only through him goes with it.
